d: In this video, The Lallantop’s Vikas Verma explained Chinese intelligence agencies and their Modus Operandi. A 50-year-old woman, suspected of being a Chinese spy, was detained in Delhi. The suspect, named Cai Ruo, was arrested by the Delhi Police's anti-terror unit in 2022 at Majnu Ka Tila. In his operational paper, "Chinese Intelligence: From a Party Outfit to Cyber Warriors," Ajit Doval explained that the methods used by Chinese intelligence are distinctly shaped by Chinese cultural traits.
